status: PAPER_ONLY_PRE_REGISTRATION - not investment advice, zero capital sanctioned
rule: Pre-registered BEFORE any entry price was fetched. Ranks and tiers are frozen; the tracker may add entry_price/entry_date and returns, and may never reorder, re-tier or rewrite a thesis. A pick is only ever demoted to NO_PRICE/NO_DATA, never silently dropped.
why_this_exists: The 200-round programme has produced zero money-ready classes. Rather than claim otherwise, this register freezes the least-bad defensible choice per class, labelled by evidence tier, so that forward data can judge it honestly.

what_i_would_actually_hold.core: VT (or SPY if you want US only) - one line, lowest cost, no selection claim
what_i_would_actually_hold.cash_sleeve: BIL / T-bill - beats most of our bond and commodity results after cost
what_i_would_actually_hold.commodity: 0% - buy-and-hold measured at -0.81%/yr with a -62.5% drawdown; no trend rule we tested beat it
what_i_would_actually_hold.crypto: 0% core; if held at all, <=5% and labelled BETA, not alpha (BTC Sharpe 0.911, DD -83%)
what_i_would_actually_hold.one_line: Buy the index, hold T-bills, stop paying for signals until one survives 2x cost and honest multiplicity.
